build_model_cpu_offload: build a model with full CPU offload so all parameters are offloaded to CPU and loaded on GPU during forward pass
build_model_disk_offload: build a model with disk offload so all parameters are stored as memory-mapped arrays on disk and loaded on demand
create_empty_model_init: create an empty model using meta device initialization to avoid allocating RAM for large models
dispatch_model_device_map: dispatch a model across multiple devices using a device map to spread layers across GPUs, CPU, and disk
load_checkpoint_and_dispatch: load a checkpoint into a model and automatically dispatch weights to the right devices based on a device map
